method: Built-in image_gen. Reception is the master reference; hallway is derived from reception. The other four scenes reference hallway. JPEGs are optimized copies of generated PNGs. Fictional illustrative facility, not real Little Panda photographs.

prompts.reception: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: one landscape 3:2 architectural photograph for a connected click-through virtual tour of a fictional Little Panda daycare, no people. This is the master reference for one consistent building. Camera at adult eye level, natural 24mm architectural lens, straight verticals. View from just inside the main entrance looking into a small welcoming reception room. Pale warm white walls, honey-colored white oak plank floor running toward the rear, pale sky-blue lower wall panels, white ceiling, small coral upholstered bench and wooden shoe cubbies on the left, small oak reception desk on the right with a small potted plant. At the exact center of rear wall a wide rounded archway leads into a short bright hallway. Through the archway clearly see an open dusty BLUE classroom door on the LEFT side of hallway, an open muted CORAL playroom door on the RIGHT, and a single sage GREEN glazed patio door at the far end. Visible hints of colorful wooden children's furniture through classroom doors. Entrance doorway is behind the camera. Restrained welcoming real daycare architecture, sunlit, lovingly arranged, not luxurious, no reception signs or text, no logos, no words, no people, no floating interface, no arrows. Maintain simple believable room geometry. Leave the central archway unobstructed so it can be clicked.
prompts.hallway: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Reference image is the master architecture of ONE fictional daycare. Generate a single landscape 3:2 photograph from a new viewpoint: move the camera FORWARD through the central rounded reception archway, and stand in the hallway just before the two classroom doors, facing the sage green patio door. Keep precisely the same floor plan and materials: white oak plank floor, pale sky-blue vertical lower wall paneling, warm white upper walls, white ceiling with round recessed lights, white trim. Dusty BLUE open glass-panel classroom door on LEFT, muted CORAL open glass-panel playroom door on RIGHT; sage GREEN glass patio door directly ahead at end opens toward the small planted garden shown in reference. Doors must remain in exactly these relative positions. Because camera is closer, left blue door and right coral door are larger, and there is no reception desk or bench visible. Through left doorway see round light wood child tables, a blue round rug and rainbow stacking toy. Through right doorway see low oak toy shelves, little wooden playhouse and peach round rug with bunting. Aim the camera slightly wide to clearly frame both left and right door openings and the far green door as clickable destinations. Quiet warm daylight, no people, no signs, no text, no arrows or interface. This is a spatial continuation of the reference, NOT a new unrelated hallway.
prompts.entrance: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Produce ONE landscape 3:2 architectural photograph, adult eye-level 24mm lens, straight verticals, natural daylight, no people, no text, no logos, no interface, no arrows. The attached reference is the EXACT fictional daycare building; this is another connected viewpoint in that same building, preserving honey oak plank floor, warm white upper walls, sky-blue vertical lower wall paneling, white trim, and the distinctive dusty blue classroom, coral playroom and sage green garden doors. View from outside at the front of this daycare, facing the MAIN entrance (a different door from the rear garden door). A modest one-story warm-white stucco building with a natural oak glazed main entrance door beneath a shallow rounded canopy. Door occupies middle of photo, open enough to see the reception beyond: coral bench and oak shoe cubbies at left, small oak reception desk at right, and the rounded hallway arch centered beyond. Clearly see the same hallway green door very far beyond the arch if possible. Small planted beds with pink flowers on either side, brick path leading to main door, pale sky. Main door and reception must be connected and unobstructed. Welcoming real small daycare, not a mansion or storefront.
